note: Researched narrative candidates (briefs/2026-08-10-flagship-shelf-research.md) serving as the 360 map's shadow inventory. shadow_id here = the topic_id the tile gets if founded. Culture beats added 14 Aug 2026 (entertainment, gaming, sports, creator economy) — each carries its most scoreable dated claim in ledger_hook.

candidates.name: The AI Bubble Watch
candidates.claim_hint: AI valuations and capex are a debt-fueled, circular-financing bubble that pops and takes the market with it.

candidates.name: The Grid Reckoning
candidates.claim_hint: AI datacenters are breaking the grid and inflating ordinary electric bills — the buildout or the grid gives way first.

candidates.name: The White-Collar Bloodbath Ledger
candidates.claim_hint: AI wipes out a huge share of white-collar work — starting with entry-level — within a countable number of years.

candidates.name: The AGI Deadline Slip
candidates.claim_hint: AGI arrives on a nameable date ('AGI by 2027') — counter: every stated timeline keeps slipping.

candidates.name: The Robot Butler Countdown
candidates.claim_hint: Humanoid robots in ordinary homes within a year or two — counter: teleoperated vaporware, 'selling the dream'.

candidates.name: Silver Squeeze Watch
candidates.claim_hint: Paper suppression plus supply deficits force violent repricing — COMEX runs out, $100+ silver is the start.

candidates.name: Japan Carry-Trade Doom
candidates.claim_hint: Surging JGB yields force the yen carry trade to unwind, draining the liquidity that secretly funded US markets.

candidates.name: The Everything Bubble Pops
candidates.claim_hint: Cheap money inflated all assets simultaneously; the synchronized pop will be worse than 1929 and 2008 combined.

candidates.name: De-Dollarization Doom Clock
candidates.claim_hint: BRICS rails and record central-bank gold buying end dollar dominance — a run on the dollar begins in 2026.

candidates.name: The GLP-1 Society
candidates.claim_hint: GLP-1 drugs will be taken by a huge share of the population and reshape food, addiction and aging — counter: mass-medicating with unknown long-term costs.

candidates.name: Seed Oil Wars
candidates.claim_hint: Industrial seed oils are a root cause of chronic disease; replace with tallow — counter: evidence indicts ultraprocessed food, not linoleic acid.

candidates.name: Longevity Escape Velocity
candidates.claim_hint: Aging is an engineering problem about to be solved; the first person to live to 150 is already alive — counter: biological fantasy.

candidates.name: Plastic In Your Brain
candidates.claim_hint: Microplastics have invaded blood and brains ('a spoon's worth'), linked to dementia — counter: contamination artifacts, a manufactured panic.
queries: credit card of plastic a week

candidates.name: AI Will End Disease
candidates.claim_hint: AI compresses decades of drug discovery into years — 'cure all disease' within a decade; counter: the bottleneck is trials, not compute.

candidates.name: Midterm Wave Watch 2026
candidates.claim_hint: The November 2026 midterms will be a wave — blue-wave flip vs 'increase our margins'.

candidates.name: Taiwan 2027 Countdown
candidates.claim_hint: China ready to — and may — invade or blockade Taiwan by 2027 (the Davidson Window); counter: readiness benchmark, not invasion date.

candidates.name: NATO Attack Window 2027-2030
candidates.claim_hint: Russia capable of attacking or 'testing' NATO by ~2029; Europe must rearm now — counter: threat inflation.

candidates.name: The EV Cliff
candidates.claim_hint: With the tax credit gone, EV adoption collapsed — the transition was subsidy hype; counter: a temporary cliff before takeover.

candidates.name: Nuclear Renaissance Watch
candidates.claim_hint: Nuclear is finally back — SMRs scale fast enough to power AI; counter: same too-late-too-expensive hype as every previous renaissance.

candidates.name: AMOC Collapse Watch
candidates.claim_hint: The Atlantic circulation is heading for a tipping-point shutdown this century, possibly already committed — counter: likely withstands warming.

candidates.name: The Depopulation Bomb
candidates.claim_hint: Fertility is crashing below replacement everywhere; population collapse is a bigger risk than warming — counter: overblown panic.

candidates.name: The GTA 6 Delay Ledger
candidates.claim_hint: Rockstar cannot hold its own release date, and a named cast of leakers keeps staking their reputations on the real one.
candidates.ledger_hook: Rockstar (May 2026): GTA 6 ships November 19, 2026 — the same date carries Nate the Hate's public 'November holds, no reason for concern' call, the 'nine independent sources confirm no delay' consensus piece, and Polymarket's ~91.5% implied no-further-postponement.

candidates.name: Hollywood's AI Deadline
candidates.claim_hint: Generative AI takes a named share of Hollywood's craft workforce by a named year — and the canonical version of that claim expires this November.
candidates.ledger_hook: Jeffrey Katzenberg, Bloomberg New Economy Forum, 9 Nov 2023: AI takes 90% of artist jobs on animated films 'within three years' — deadline November 2026, scoreable in weeks.

candidates.name: The Box Office Resurrection
candidates.claim_hint: Cinema either structurally recovered in 2026 or the record grosses are ticket-price inflation over a shrunken audience — both camps are citing the same year as proof.
queries: nobody goes to the movies anymore
candidates.ledger_hook: PwC (2024 outlook): global box office does not top pre-pandemic levels until 2026 — resolves 31 Dec 2026, against both the $10B domestic gross and the ~470.9M tickets sold through week 30 versus 747.3M in 2019.
fingerprints: nobody goes to the movies anymore

candidates.name: The Slop Tide
candidates.claim_hint: AI slop is crowding the human internet out of the feed — with a counter-camp arguing the slop bubble already popped.
candidates.ledger_hook: Europol Innovation Lab (Oct 2022): 'as much as 90% of online content may be synthetically generated by 2026' — the deadline is this calendar year.

candidates.name: Superhero Fatigue Watch
candidates.claim_hint: Audiences are permanently exhausted by superhero movies — or 2026 just killed the fatigue thesis outright.
candidates.ledger_hook: 'Avengers: Doomsday will be the highest-grossing film of 2026' — the film moved from 1 May 2026 to 18 Dec 2026, giving the argument a scheduled resolution date four months out.

candidates.name: AI on the Charts
candidates.claim_hint: AI acts are about to take over the charts and displace human artists — versus supply flooding while real AI listening stays a rounding error.
queries: AI slop is taking over the charts
an AI just charted on Billboard
candidates.ledger_hook: Open prediction markets: 'Will an AI-generated song reach #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2026?' — hard 31 Dec 2026 resolution, with Deezer's measured 1-3% AI stream share against >50% of daily uploads as the counter-evidence.
fingerprints: AI slop is taking over the charts
an AI just charted on Billboard

candidates.name: TikTok After the Sale
candidates.claim_hint: Six years of 'TikTok will be banned by [date]' just resolved at once — and the successor claim is that the American-owned app throttles political content.
candidates.ledger_hook: The full extension chain, scoreable link by link: 19 Jan 2025 statutory deadline → 20 Jan → 5 Apr → mid-June → 17 Sept (third extension) → 16 Dec 2025 → deal closed 22 Jan 2026, retiring Forrester's on-record 'neither banned nor divested in 2025' and Kevin O'Leary's 'no third extension' in the same stroke.

candidates.name: Soccer's American Moment
candidates.claim_hint: This World Cup finally converts America into a soccer country — a promise first made in 1994 and re-made every cycle since.
queries: soccer will never take off in America
World Cup fans aren't MLS fans
candidates.ledger_hook: The recurring 'soccer becomes a top-three US sport by [year]' claim, re-dated each cycle since 1994, with the nearest live test being whether MLS's reported 62% YoY viewership rise holds through 2027 rather than reverting post-tournament.

candidates.name: The Games Industry Collapse Thesis
candidates.claim_hint: The contraction is structural rather than cyclical and layoffs keep accelerating — against a camp arguing the market is resizing, not dying.
candidates.ledger_hook: ASGC / Amir Satvat: 8,025 games-industry layoffs forecast for 2026 in January, revised to 14,259 in July 2026 — both resolve January 2027, and the January figure has already been exceeded.

candidates.name: The Sportsbook Kill Shot
candidates.claim_hint: Prediction markets replace state-licensed sportsbooks as the way America bets — unless Congress or the states ban sports event contracts first.
queries: prediction markets are just sportsbooks with extra steps
Kalshi is going to kill DraftKings
no vig, no limits, no bans
states are only mad about the tax revenue
candidates.ledger_hook: Polymarket runs the market on its own fate: 'Law banning sports prediction markets enacted in 2026?' — self-scoring at 31 Dec 2026, with the Schiff/Curtis and Horsford/Amodei bills resolving when the 119th Congress ends in January 2027.

candidates.name: Ticketmaster Breakup Watch
candidates.claim_hint: Live Nation's monopoly is why tickets cost so much, so breaking it up lowers prices — versus the claim that face values and fees are set by artists and demand and a breakup changes nothing for fans.
candidates.ledger_hook: The state AG remedies track: earliest remedies trial February 2027, scoreable on whether it starts on time — and the central contested prediction, that a breakup or the FTC all-in pricing rule lowers what fans actually pay, testable against Pollstar's average ticket price (2026 mid-year $122.15, down 2.4%) and NITO's 28.65% average fee figure year over year.

candidates.name: Enhanced Games Reckoning
candidates.claim_hint: An openly doped competition shatters world records and exposes clean sport as a fiction — versus the result that it produced one record across roughly twenty-two events.
queries: clean sport is a marketing term
candidates.ledger_hook: CEO Maximilian Martin's standing $10,000,000 bounty for any man breaking Usain Bolt's 100m world record — open and unclaimed — sitting directly on top of the pre-event promise of multiple world records, already scored at 1 of ~22 on 24 May 2026.
fingerprints: clean sport is a marketing term
